<span id="_1-产品概述"></span>
# 1. Product overview

Visual modeling provides external output capabilities, allowing offline tables generated by intelligent data insights to flow back to your own native system for secondary data production and mining, enabling more flexible data output and application. Currently supported external storage: MaxCompute, OceanBase Oracle, Mysql, LAS (public cloud), Transwarp Inceptor, Oracle, BytehouseCE.

<span id="_2-使用条件"></span>
# 2. Usage conditions

This feature is a value\-added function for the private deployment version and requires a paid purchase. To use this feature, please contact your account manager. After purchase, users must have **Project Center \- Data Preparation \- Visual Modeling \- Create Task** permissions, and the customer side must allow table creation and data writing.

<span id="_3-3-操作步骤"></span>
## 3.3 Operating steps

(1) Click **Data Preparation \> Data Connection**.

<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/85863b4137044b7784c6911eed7453e6~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

(2) In the upper left corner of the data connection directory, click the **New Data Connection** button. Using MaxCompute as an example, select the **Data Warehouse \- MaxCompute** data connection.

<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/9d99af3ef23f47dd84ee5e1d85f87437~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

(3) On the edit page, fill in the corresponding server and key information, enable **Write** permission in the permission mode, and after the connection test is successful, click **Save**.

<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/baa397af928f4d89acf0def14c6aa610~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

(4) Click **Visual Modeling \- Create Task**;

<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/864d0ec99a4d46eeb2929c1afac40e3d~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

(5) On the task editing page, you can freely perform data cleaning and processing. After completion, add the **External Output** operator;

(6) The process for creating new tables and viewing table information has been simplified. Relevant content can be displayed directly in the toolbar, improving your operational efficiency.


* Create a new output table and fill in the relevant information.

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/c03d1aaba8134525ab69c6738757d326~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

* You can view the output table directly in the toolbar or preview the table structure.
